CREATE TABLE teacher_telegram_link_code (
    code_hash BYTEA PRIMARY KEY CHECK (octet_length(code_hash) = 32),
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    consumed_telegram_user_id BIGINT,
    consumed_chat_id BIGINT,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id)
        REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id),
    CHECK ((consumed_at IS NULL) = (consumed_telegram_user_id IS NULL AND consumed_chat_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK (consumed_telegram_user_id IS NULL OR consumed_telegram_user_id > 0),
    CHECK (consumed_chat_id IS NULL OR consumed_chat_id > 0)
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_telegram_link_code_student_idx
    ON teacher_telegram_link_code (student_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE teacher_telegram_binding (
    student_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    telegram_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (telegram_user_id > 0),
    chat_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (chat_id > 0),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id)
        REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id)
);

CREATE TABLE teacher_telegram_delivery (
    source_message_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teacher_telegram_binding(student_id),
    chat_id BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (chat_id > 0),
    body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(body) <> '' AND octet_length(body) <= 48000),
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'sent', 'blocked')),
    claim_token UUID,
    locked_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    remote_message_id BIGINT,
    last_error_code VARCHAR(64),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CHECK ((status = 'processing') = (claim_token IS NOT NULL AND locked_until IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (status = 'processing' OR (claim_token IS NULL AND locked_until IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((status = 'sent') = (remote_message_id IS NOT NULL AND sent_at IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_telegram_delivery_pending_idx
    ON teacher_telegram_delivery (next_attempt_at, created_at, source_message_id)
    WHERE status IN ('pending', 'processing');
